lines.zh: 纸板怎么走？我立在这儿
lines.en: How would cardboard walk? I stand here

lines.zh: 我被压在地板上的座里
lines.en: I am fixed into a base on the floor

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的边角会响
lines.en: When wind comes, my edges rustle

lines.zh: 要走的是你，不是我
lines.en: You are the one who walks, not I

lines.zh: 一张纸板，两公斤重
lines.en: A sheet of cardboard, a couple of kilos

lines.zh: 我背后有支架撑着
lines.en: There is a bracket holding my back

lines.zh: 这一排立牌，只有我是正面
lines.en: Of this row, only I face forward

lines.zh: 走过走廊的人，都在我这一面
lines.en: Everyone down this hall passes my face

lines.zh: 我走不了，可我的影子会挪
lines.en: I cannot walk, yet my shadow shifts

lines.zh: 有人把我挪过地方，我记得
lines.en: Someone moved me once, I remember

lines.zh: 脚步在纸板边上，很轻
lines.en: Steps by cardboard are very light

lines.zh: 日头偏西，我的影子变长
lines.en: The sun leans west and my shadow lengthens

lines.zh: 我立着，边角已经卷了
lines.en: I stand here, my corners curled

lines.zh: 纸板背面能看见印刷的字
lines.en: The printing shows on my back

lines.zh: 这张脸印得很平
lines.en: This face is printed very flat

lines.zh: 一只眼睛的墨淡了
lines.en: The ink on one eye has faded

lines.zh: 我不会动，这是纸做的
lines.en: I cannot move, this is paper

lines.zh: 灰尘落在我的肩上
lines.en: Dust gathers on my shoulder

lines.zh: 灯光照着我，纸面发亮
lines.en: The lamp lights me and the board shines

lines.zh: 门开着，可我出不去
lines.en: The door is open, yet I cannot leave

lines.zh: 我在这儿当摆设很久了
lines.en: I have been an ornament here a long while

lines.zh: 这餐厅的墙纸和我很配
lines.en: The wallpaper here suits me

lines.zh: 你站得正，我看得清
lines.en: You stand square, I can see you clearly

lines.zh: 纸板上的眼睛不会动，只会被看
lines.en: Eyes on cardboard do not move, they are only looked at

lines.zh: 我跟真人一样高，差一点
lines.en: I am almost life height, almost

lines.zh: 你敲一下，就知道我是空的
lines.en: Knock once and you will know I am hollow

lines.zh: 你正对着我的脸
lines.en: You are square in front of my face

lines.zh: 这个角度，我的眼是平的
lines.en: At this angle my eyes are flat

lines.zh: 你要合影吗，我不收钱
lines.en: Want a picture? I charge nothing

lines.zh: 背面什么都没有，别绕过去
lines.en: There is nothing on the back, do not go around

lines.zh: 我脸上一道折痕，是旧伤
lines.en: A crease across my face, an old wound

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我在看你背后的门
lines.en: While you look at me, I look at the door behind you

lines.zh: 边角塌了一块
lines.en: A corner has caved in

lines.zh: 纸面破了个洞
lines.en: A hole punched through the board

lines.zh: 我歪了，但没倒
lines.en: I am tilted, not down

lines.zh: 纸的响声很脆
lines.en: The sound of paper is sharp

lines.zh: 这张脸多了一道裂
lines.en: A split across this face

lines.zh: 你打的是纸，手也会疼
lines.en: You struck paper, and your hand hurts too

lines.zh: 底座松了，撑不住多久
lines.en: The base is loose, it will not hold long

lines.zh: 我的墨蹭掉了
lines.en: Some of my ink has rubbed off

lines.zh: 这样下去，我迟早会被折起来
lines.en: At this rate I will be folded away

lines.zh: 我还立着，虽然不太好看
lines.en: I am still up, though not looking well

lines.zh: 我是纸做的，吃不了
lines.en: I am made of paper, I cannot eat

lines.zh: 你把东西举给一张画
lines.en: You offer food to a picture

lines.zh: 这嘴是印上去的
lines.en: That mouth is printed on

lines.zh: 食物在纸板上留下印子
lines.en: Food would leave a stain on cardboard

lines.zh: 你手别靠，纸会破
lines.en: Keep your hand back, paper tears

lines.zh: 你要留给谁，我不收
lines.en: Give it to whomever, I do not take it

lines.zh: 闻到香味，我也只能站着
lines.en: I can smell it, and I can only stand

lines.zh: 这块板子连手指都没有
lines.en: This board does not even have fingers

lines.zh: 放远点，别蹭到我脸上
lines.en: Put it farther away, do not rub my face

lines.zh: 我不动，是纸做的
lines.en: I do not move, because I am paper

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我晃了很久
lines.en: You hit me and I rocked a long while

lines.zh: 我的底座滑了半寸
lines.en: My base slid half an inch

lines.zh: 纸板很轻，一碰就歪
lines.en: Cardboard is light, one touch tilts it

lines.zh: 你再推，我就倒了
lines.en: Push again and I fall

lines.zh: 我的边角被你撞塌了一块
lines.en: A corner of mine has caved in from your bump

lines.zh: 我歪着，还是正对着你
lines.en: Tilted as I am, I still face you

lines.zh: 这一下，我背后的支架断了
lines.en: That broke the bracket behind me

lines.zh: 你踩到我的底座了
lines.en: You stepped on my base

lines.zh: 我没有让开的本事
lines.en: I have no way to step aside

lines.zh: 轻些，纸不会喊疼
lines.en: Gently, paper does not cry out

lines.zh: 我是一张印出来的脸
lines.en: I am a printed face

lines.zh: 你的话穿过去了，后面没有东西
lines.en: Your words go through me, there is nothing behind

lines.zh: 纸板和纸板，也只是并排站着
lines.en: Cardboard and cardboard only stand side by side

lines.zh: 我背后是空的
lines.en: My back is empty

lines.zh: 这张脸不会红
lines.en: This face cannot blush

lines.zh: 你要找伴，去后面那条街
lines.en: If you want company, try the street behind

lines.zh: 我连摇头都不会
lines.en: I cannot even shake my head

lines.zh: 我的关节是折出来的
lines.en: My joints are folds

lines.zh: 你笑吧，纸不生气
lines.en: Laugh if you like, paper takes no offense

lines.zh: 说完就走，别碰我的支架
lines.en: Say your piece and go, do not touch my bracket

lines.zh: 我没有手，东西落在我脚下
lines.en: I have no hands, things land at my base

lines.zh: 纸片落在我脚边，很像我的碎片
lines.en: A scrap fell by me, it looks like part of me

lines.zh: 我够不着，只能看着
lines.en: I cannot reach it, I can only look

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我站这儿
lines.en: You take it, I stand here

lines.zh: 这张板子连弯都弯不了
lines.en: This board cannot even bend

lines.zh: 东西靠在我腿上，晃了一下
lines.en: It leaned on my leg and I swayed

lines.zh: 你要是把它拿走，别碰倒我
lines.en: Carry it off, just leave me upright

lines.zh: 我脚下这一圈归我
lines.en: The circle at my base is mine

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，压在我的边上
lines.en: It fell and rests against my edge

lines.zh: 看一眼，也算我捡过
lines.en: A look counts as having picked it up

lines.zh: 我看见你了，纸板也能看
lines.en: I see you, cardboard can see too

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是印上去的，可正对着你
lines.en: My eyes are printed, and they face you

lines.zh: 你走进这条走廊，就对着我
lines.en: Step into this hall and you face me

lines.zh: 我站的位置，正好挡住路
lines.en: My spot blocks the way

lines.zh: 我不动，你就得绕
lines.en: I will not move, so you must go around

lines.zh: 灯光照在这张脸上
lines.en: The lamp falls on this face

lines.zh: 这张脸对着门，很多年了
lines.en: This face has looked at the door for years

lines.zh: 你别以为纸板不会看人
lines.en: Do not think cardboard cannot watch people

lines.zh: 你一停下，就正对着我
lines.en: The moment you stop, you are facing me

lines.zh: 我的眼窝是印的，也是空的
lines.en: My sockets are printed and empty

lines.zh: 你走近的时候，我的折痕动了一下
lines.en: When you came closer, my crease shifted

lines.zh: 这一排我只认正面
lines.en: Of this row I only know my front

lines.zh: 走廊尽头，就我一张脸
lines.en: At the end of the hall, only my face

lines.zh: 你听，纸在响
lines.en: Listen, the paper is rustling

lines.zh: 我不喊，纸没有嗓子
lines.en: I will not shout, paper has no throat

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我还是原来的角度
lines.en: You stepped back half a pace, my angle is unchanged

lines.zh: 你走远了，脸还对着你
lines.en: You walk away, and the face still faces you

lines.zh: 纸板不会转头，可角度没变
lines.en: Cardboard cannot turn, and the angle has not changed

lines.zh: 你绕到侧面，看得见我的薄
lines.en: From the side you can see how thin I am

lines.zh: 你又回到我正面了
lines.en: You are back in front of me

lines.zh: 走廊不长，你我之间没有什么
lines.en: The hall is short, there is nothing between us

lines.zh: 我看不见了，可我记得方向
lines.en: I cannot see now, but I remember the direction

lines.zh: 纸上这道折痕越来越深
lines.en: The crease on the paper grows deeper

lines.zh: 有人在我背后走过
lines.en: Someone passed behind me

lines.zh: 这地方的灯，越来越暗
lines.en: The lights here are getting dimmer

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我还在原处
lines.en: When you look back, I am still where I was

lines.zh: 我的影子拉到了你脚下
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet

lines.zh: 纸板在夜里会自己响
lines.en: Cardboard creaks on its own at night

lines.zh: 我不动，你却不能不管我
lines.en: I do not move, but you cannot ignore me

lines.zh: 这一层楼，我站在最中间
lines.en: On this floor, I stand dead center

lines.zh: 你数着走过去，我再数你回来
lines.en: You count your way out, I count you back

lines.zh: 门关上以后，就只剩我
lines.en: When the door shuts, only I am left

lines.zh: 那盏灯正对着我的脸
lines.en: That lamp is aimed at my face

lines.zh: 我的边角开始起毛
lines.en: My edges are fraying

lines.zh: 这层楼的地板，每一步都响
lines.en: Every step on this floor sounds

lines.zh: 你离我越远，越觉得不对
lines.en: The further you get, the more wrong it feels

lines.zh: 我不会出手，我只是一张纸
lines.en: I do not strike, I am only a sheet

lines.zh: 你撞上来，反倒被边角划了
lines.en: You rammed in and my edge cut you

lines.zh: 纸很薄，可边很利
lines.en: Paper is thin, but the edge is sharp

lines.zh: 我的底座绊了你一脚
lines.en: My base tripped your foot

lines.zh: 你挥手把我打歪了，手也红了
lines.en: You knocked me askew and your hand reddened

lines.zh: 灯一闪，你的影子晃到了我身上
lines.en: The light blinked and your shadow swung across me

lines.zh: 你退的时候，撞到了我背后的架子
lines.en: Retreating, you hit the stand behind me

lines.zh: 这张脸离你越来越近，虽然我没动
lines.en: This face is closer, though I did not move

lines.zh: 你在原地转圈，我一直对着你
lines.en: You turn in circles, and I keep facing you

lines.zh: 我的印刷眼睛落了一点墨
lines.en: A drop of ink runs from my printed eye

lines.zh: 你伸手，摸到的只是纸
lines.en: Reach out and you touch only paper

lines.zh: 纸板割破了你的手背
lines.en: The cardboard cut the back of your hand

lines.zh: 你被吓了一跳，脚下打滑
lines.en: You startled and your feet slipped

lines.zh: 我一歪，你的路窄了一半
lines.en: I tilt and half your path is gone

lines.zh: 你听见纸在响，就在耳边
lines.en: You hear paper rustle, right by your ear

lines.zh: 这一下，折痕裂开了
lines.en: That split the crease

lines.zh: 你退开时，我还在看你
lines.en: As you back off, I am still watching

lines.zh: 我什么都没有做，可你出汗了
lines.en: I did nothing, and you are sweating

lines.zh: 你还站着，那就再站一会儿
lines.en: You are still standing, so stand a while longer

lines.zh: 这张纸板，比你想象的沉
lines.en: This board is heavier than you think

lines.zh: 餐厅的墙边，立着一张纸板
lines.en: A standee stands by the diner wall

lines.zh: 印刷的油墨味还没散
lines.en: The smell of printing ink has not faded

lines.zh: 它被摆正的瞬间，灯亮了
lines.en: As it was set upright, the light came on

lines.zh: 走廊尽头多了一张脸
lines.en: A face has appeared at the end of the hall

lines.zh: 底座压在旧地板上，发出轻响
lines.en: The base settles on old boards with a light creak

lines.zh: 这一排立牌里，它是最新的
lines.en: Of the row, it is the newest

lines.zh: 有人把它放下，就再没回来
lines.en: Someone set it down and never came back

lines.zh: 一个人的高度，一张纸的厚度
lines.en: A person's height, a sheet's thickness

lines.zh: 它正面对着门，角度刚好
lines.en: It faces the door at just the right angle

lines.zh: 地板上的印子，是它的位置
lines.en: The mark on the floor is its place

lines.zh: 这张脸在昏暗里，比灯还显眼
lines.en: In the dim it stands out more than the lamp

lines.zh: 一阵风，边角抬起来又落下
lines.en: A draft lifts a corner and drops it

lines.zh: 火一烧，边角卷成黑的
lines.en: Fire touched me and the edge curled black

lines.zh: 我倒下了，纸面拍在地上
lines.en: I fell and the board slapped the floor

lines.zh: 纸吸了水，软塌塌地垂下来
lines.en: The paper drank water and sagged

lines.zh: 一下子被撕成了两半
lines.en: Torn clean in two in an instant

lines.zh: 一支箭从正面穿了过去
lines.en: An arrow went straight through the front

lines.zh: 墨自己流了起来，脸变形了
lines.en: The ink began to run and the face warped

lines.zh: 纸不会饿，可它也会干裂
lines.en: Paper does not starve, it dries and cracks

lines.zh: 一道白光，把我照成了剪影
lines.en: A white flash turned me into a silhouette

lines.zh: 这里没有地板，我无处可立
lines.en: No floor here for me to stand on
